title: Dab Kit Giveaway Official Rules: Win a Dr. Dabber Kit | BUZZY
description: Enter BUZZY’s 2026 Dab Kit Sweepstakes in Brooklyn! Win a premium Dr. Dabber kit. Review official rules, eligibility, and enter online or in-store today.

blocks.html: NO PURCHASE NECESSARY TO ENTER OR WIN. A PURCHASE WILL NOT INCREASE YOUR CHANCES OF WINNING.
BUZZY NY, LLC, 137 Court St, Cobble Hill, Brooklyn, NY 11201 (“Sponsor”).

Open to legal residents of New York State who are 21 years of age or older at the time of entry. Employees of BUZZY NY, LLC, Dr.Dabber, and their respective affiliates, subsidiaries, agents, and immediate family members are not eligible. Void where prohibited by law.

The BUZZY x Dr.Dabber “Win a Dab Kit” Sweepstakes (“Sweepstakes”) begins on JULY 1st, 2026 at 12:00 ET and ends on July 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (“Promotion Period”). Entries received outside the Promotion Period will not be eligible.

Method 1 — Purchase Entry: During the Promotion Period, visit BUZZY in-store at 137 Court St, Cobble Hill, Brooklyn, NY and make a single-transaction purchase of $150 or more on vapes and/or concentrates. One (1) entry will be automatically recorded per qualifying transaction. Multiple qualifying transactions during the Promotion Period each earn one (1) entry.
Method 2 — No Purchase (Alternate Method of Entry): To enter without a purchase, complete both of the following steps during the Promotion Period:

items: Sign up for the BUZZY loyalty program in-store at 137 Court St, Cobble Hill, Brooklyn, NY or at getbuzzy.com/rewards; AND
Post a public photo or video on Instagram and tag @visitbuzzy in the post. The account must be set to public at the time of posting so the entry can be verified.

blocks.html: One (1) free entry per person. No purchase required. Free entries have the same chance of winning as purchase entries. Entries that do not include both steps will not be eligible. Sponsor is not responsible for entries not received due to private account settings.
One (1) Grand Prize: One (1) Dr.Dabber Dab Kit. Approximate Retail Value (ARV): $489.85.

Prize is non-transferable and may not be redeemed for cash. No substitutions except at Sponsor’s sole discretion. Sponsor reserves the right to substitute a prize of equal or greater value if the stated prize becomes unavailable.

One (1) winner will be selected by random drawing from all eligible entries received during the Promotion Period. Drawing will take place on or around August 1st, 2026. Odds of winning depend on the total number of eligible entries received.

The potential winner will be notified in-store or by the contact information provided at time of entry. The potential winner must respond within five (5) business days of notification or an alternate winner may be selected. Prize will be available for in-store pickup at 137 Court St, Cobble Hill, Brooklyn, NY within 10 days of winner confirmation.

Sponsor reserves the right to cancel, suspend, or modify the Sweepstakes if fraud, technical failures, or any other factor beyond Sponsor’s reasonable control impairs the integrity of the Sweepstakes, as determined by Sponsor in its sole discretion. Sponsor reserves the right to disqualify any individual found to be tampering with the entry process or otherwise acting in violation of these Official Rules.

By entering, participants agree to release and hold harmless BUZZY NY, LLC, Dr.Dabber, and their respective officers, directors, employees, and agents from any liability, loss, or damage of any kind arising from or in connection with the Sweepstakes or the prize. Sponsor is not responsible for lost, late, misdirected, or incomplete entries.

Personal information collected in connection with this Sweepstakes will be used only for the purpose of administering the Sweepstakes and will not be sold or shared with third parties except as necessary to administer the prize.

This Sweepstakes is in no way sponsored, endorsed, or administered by, or associated with, Meta Platforms, Inc. or Instagram. Any questions or comments regarding the Sweepstakes should be directed to BUZZY NY, LLC, not to Meta or Instagram.
This Sweepstakes is governed by the laws of the State of New York. All disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Kings County, New York.
For a complete copy of the Official Rules, ask a budtender in-store at 137 Court St, Cobble Hill, Brooklyn, NY or contact us at [email protected].
